blocks.prompt: 3 (a) Figure 7.11 is the velocity-time graph of Aslam's motion as he runs along a straight track. For the first 5 seconds, he accelerates uniformly from rest to a velocity of 8 m/s. He then maintains this velocity for a further 8 seconds. Find: The rate at which Aslam accelerates.
blocks.explanation:
"Rate at which he accelerates" ka matlab hai acceleration, aur velocity-time graph par acceleration slope hota hai.
Diya kya hai? Aslam rest (0 m/s) se 5 second mein uniformly 8 m/s tak pohanchta hai.
Find kya karna hai? Acceleration.
Plan: OA ka slope nikalna; tasdeeq ke liye \(v = u + at\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(u = 0\), \(t = 5\) s baad \(v = 8\) m/s, acceleration uniform hai.
Maloom karna: acceleration.
Tareeqa: velocity-time graph par slope \(dv/dt\) acceleration hota hai (7.1.5). Uniform acceleration ka matlab hai graph seedhi line hai, yahan OA.

OA ka slope
\[a = \dfrac{8 - 0}{5 - 0}\]
\[= \dfrac{8}{5} = 1.6\text{ m/s}^2\]
Kyun: slope = velocity mein tabdeeli / time mein tabdeeli. Har second velocity 1.6 m/s barhti hai.
Dhyan dein: unit m/s\(^2\) hai, sirf m/s nahi; kyunke m/s ko phir second se divide kiya.

Tasdeeq: \(v = u + at\) se
\[0 + 1.6 \times 5 = 8 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: motion ki pehli equation se final velocity dobara 8 m/s aani chahiye, aur aa gayi.

blocks.prompt: 3 (b) Figure 7.11 is the velocity-time graph of Aslam's motion as he runs along a straight track. For the first 5 seconds, he accelerates uniformly from rest to a velocity of 8 m/s. He then maintains this velocity for a further 8 seconds. Find: The displacement from the starting point of Aslam after 13 seconds.
blocks.explanation:
Velocity-time graph ke neeche ka area displacement hota hai.
Diya kya hai? Graph ke points O(0, 0), A(5, 8), B(13, 8), C(13, 0).
Find kya karna hai? 13 second baad starting point se displacement.
Plan: OABC ek trapezium hai; Example 5 ki tarah us ka area nikalna.
steps:
Diya gaya: kone wale points O(0, 0), A(5, 8), B(13, 8), C(13, 0) aur D(5, 0).
Maloom karna: 13 s baad displacement.
Tareeqa: displacement = velocity-time graph ke neeche ka area, \(t = 0\) se \(t = 13\) tak (7.1.5). Shakal OABC ek trapezium hai (do sides parallel), is liye formula \(\frac{1}{2}(a + b)h\).

Trapezium ki sides
\[|OC| = 13,\quad |AB| = 13 - 5 = 8\]
\[h = 8\]
Kyun: OC (neeche) aur AB (oopar) parallel sides hain. AB 5 se 13 tak hai, to us ki lambai 8 hai. Height constant velocity 8 m/s hai.
Dhyan dein: AB ko 13 na le lein; AB to sirf 5 se shuru hoti hai.

Area
\[x = \dfrac{1}{2}(13 + 8) \times 8\]
\[= 84\text{ m}\]
Kyun: trapezium ka area = parallel sides ke jama ka aadha, zarb un ke beech ka faasla. Units: (m/s) zarb s = m, is liye jawab meters mein.

Tasdeeq: triangle jama rectangle
\[\tfrac{1}{2}(5)(8) + 8 \times 8\]
\[= 20 + 64 = 84 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: trapezium asal mein triangle OAD (jab Aslam tez ho raha tha) aur rectangle DABC (jab woh ek hi raftaar se daur raha tha) ka jama hai. Dono tareeqon se 84 aaya.
